identity.title: [v0.92][runtime][shepherd] Pull local Gemma/MLX Shepherd MVP forward

values.task_boundary: Deliver real local model-backed Shepherd dialogue through governed Runtime v3 and Observatory surfaces.
deliverables: Runtime provider adapter and governed command/response path for configured local MLX/Gemma
Observatory interaction, truthful status, real smoke, deterministic regression, and negative-case evidence
acceptance_criteria: A configured local MLX/Gemma model produces a real Shepherd response through Runtime v3
The Observatory sends the bounded command and renders response/result evidence
Status distinguishes unavailable, deterministic test double, and real local-model execution
No-model, timeout, malformed command, and unsigned or unauthorized mutation cases fail truthfully
Deterministic adapter regressions and a real local model smoke both pass
Freedom Gate, CAV, constitutional policy, and advisory-only authority remain enforced
The global default model is unchanged and no AWS or cloud path is used
One exact-revision review has no unresolved actionable findings
dependencies: WP-14 contract stability before final Observatory integration
non_goals: Full v0.95 Shepherd or Gemma program
Success credit from a deterministic fake alone
